title: One Piece: Episode of Luffy - Hand Island Adventure
summary: The sixth One Piece TV special (2 hours, 土曜プレミアム, Fuji TV 2012-12-15 21:00-23:10 per syobocal PID 247314/247316/247320), aired the same day One Piece Film: Z opened. THE PREMISE REPRODUCED, NOT INHERITED: I re-read both primaries. The One Piece Wiki's Episode Box prints chapter = Chapter 1 (p. 4-47) / Chapter 2 (p. 4, 8, 9-10, 13-22), and ja-WP says in as many words 「原作を元にしたストーリーが展開されるこれまでの「エピソード」シリーズとは異なり、完全新作ストーリーを中心に構成されている。物語の中ではルフィやコビーの回想という形で、原作第1話・第2話の赤髪海賊団やアルビダ一味とのシーンがリメイクされている」 — an original story whose flashbacks REMAKE chs 1-2. Three further primaries agree the story is original: Fuji TV's own programme page (Wayback 2012-12-18) calls it 「完全新作の2時間スペシャル」 and 「ルフィが冒険に出るきっかけになった赤髪のシャンクスとのエピソードを含んだオリジナルストーリー」; Mantan Web (2012-12-02, the article ja-WP cites) says 完全新作 and 「ルフィは12年前…フーシャ村でのシャンクスとのエピソードを思い出す」; ANN's 2012-11-24 report of the TV ad says the special 'will also have a flashback scene to the story in the first chapter of the manga, but with new animation'. THE RECAP BOUNDARY (T28, the Shippuden-388 shape): those chapters are pages THE TV RUN ALREADY OWNS — the wiki's Episode 1 notes state 'This episode is not based on Chapter 1, which is later covered in Episode 4. Instead, it is based off of material from Chapter 2', and en-WP's season-1 summaries carry the same content (ep 1 = the barrel, Koby, Alvida; ep 4 = the whole Foosha flashback, the fruit, Higuma, Shanks's arm, the hat). So the ch 1 pp. 6-47 and ch 2 flashbacks are a RECAP share: newly drawn (not recycled footage), which under the 388 boundary is anime production weighing toward FILLER, never toward canon — it cannot give the work standing in chapters eps 1 and 4 already adapted. THE FIRST-TIME SHARE IS TWO PAGES. The wiki's page-level reverse index (character-page {{Qref}}s, a different instrument from the episode infobox) points every ch-1 page at ep 4 (p. 12, 14, 16, 19, 20, 29, 34, 39, 43, 44-45, 46-47) and every ch-2 page at ep 1 (p. 4-6, 5-7, 8, 8-9, 12-13, 16, 18-19, 23) — with exactly one exception: Monkey D. Luffy carries {{Qref|chap=1|page=5|ep=of Luffy|Luffy stabs himself underneath his eye to prove his toughness}} and Red Hair Pirates carries {{Qref|chap=1|page=4-5|ep=of Luffy|Luffy cuts himself on the figurehead of the ship of the Red Hair Pirates}}. That is why the infobox range starts at p. 4: ch 1 pp. 4-5 are the knife scene the 1999 TV run skipped — Episode 4's own notes say 'In the manga, Luffy cut his face and created a scar under his left eye to prove to Shanks he is a real man but this is not shown in this episode', and the special's notes say 'For the first time in the anime, the story of how Luffy got the scar under his eye is animated' (a note written 2012-12-14 as 'first time in the entire series', refined post-broadcast by two editors; the page-level range was added 2012-12-23, rev 800582). A control that the wiki tracks this chapter's first-time coverage carefully: ch 1's CLOSING pages are credited not here but to Episode 504 ('Luffy defeating the Lord of the Coast is properly shown for the first time in the anime version in this episode'), and Roger's execution (ch 1 p. 1) to ep 1. STANDING: filler. The work's job is an original Film Z tie-in — Hand Island, Diego, Regis, Bilić, Koby's inspection, the Kizaru wax ruse; the source share is a recap share plus a two-page sliver (T28's sliver clause: a fragment inside a flashback, weightless — it earns neither a type nor an anchor, and the chapters it touches are adapted properly by eps 4 and 1). I applied the SOLE-ADAPTATION EXCEPTION explicitly and it does not fire: half one HOLDS (ch 1 pp. 4-5 appear in no other episode — the coverage set makes this special their only anime appearance), half two FAILS (Luffy stabbing his cheek is a characterisation beat and the origin of a cosmetic trademark, not a major plot point of the source — no death, no reveal, no arc close; ch 1's load-bearing beats are all in ep 4). Fragments do not aggregate here either: the ch-2 share is entirely duplicate. T26 CREDITS, NOT ADOPTION: Oda is 原作 (the franchise credit; 脚本 is 堤泰之), ANN adds that he 'is supervising the special with its new story', and Fuji TV credits him with 描き下ろし designs for Koby and Helmeppo's New World forms and a コラボ character design with Kazuya Hisada for Diego/Regis/Bilić — designs and supervision, never events entering the manga line (the post-timeskip Koby/Helmeppo designs do reach the manga at ch 903, but a design is not this work's events).

position.why: CONFIRMED on the licensor's broadcast order (the KonoSuba precedent: the fandom's in-universe placement is noted, the licensor's order rules). Broadcast 2012-12-15 21:00-23:10 JST on Fuji TV (syobocal; the archived Fuji TV programme page; ja-WP; ANN), i.e. between ep 576 (2012-12-09) and ep 577 (2012-12-16) — and the One Piece Wiki's own infobox states the same run position independently, P = Episode 576 / N = Episode 577. TWO SOURCED IN-UNIVERSE PLACEMENTS EXIST AND THEY CONTRADICT EACH OTHER, so neither is a sound basis for correcting the broadcast slot: (a) the official announcement, via ANN 2012-11-24 — 'the story ... is set a little before the events of One Piece Film Z', 'a major Hand Island incident during the New World storyline' (AniList's own edge agrees in direction: this work SEQUEL → ONE PIECE FILM: Z), which would put it before the Z's Ambition arc, i.e. about 574.5; (b) the One Piece Wiki's Anime Notes — 'in the anime continuity, this special COULD take place before the Punk Hazard Arc and after Z's Ambition Arc and One Piece Film: Z ... because in the anime, the Z's Ambition Arc took place immediately after the Straw Hat Pirates entered the New World, which led into the film', i.e. about 578.5 (hedged with 'could', and its Jinbe clause is anachronistic reasoning). MATERIALLY IT DOES NOT MATTER FOR POSITION TRUTH: every episode in [575, 578] is filler (the wiki types Z's Ambition a filler arc; our grid types 575-578 filler), so the whole interval 574.5-578.5 is a chapterless zone between ep 574's END 655 and ep 579's resumption in ch 655 — no value in that interval changes a reader's manga position.

flags_for_sean: THE PREMISE HELD, with the page question answered. The wave-2 triage line reproduces: the fandom infobox's ch 1 (p. 4-47) / ch 2 (p. 4, 8, 9-10, 13-22) and ja-WP's 完全新作ストーリーを中心に…リメイク are both live and verbatim. THE SCAR PAGE IS CH 1 pp. 4-5 (the stab itself p. 5), sourced: {{Qref|chap=1|page=5|ep=of Luffy}} on Monkey D. Luffy and {{Qref|chap=1|page=4-5|ep=of Luffy}} on Red Hair Pirates. Its weight is SLIVER — two pages, one characterisation beat inside a flashback; the rest of ch 1 is adapted properly by ep 4, ch 2 by ep 1.

WHAT A `filler` + `chapters_adapted: []` DELIVERY LOSES, stated so it is not lost: ch 1 pp. 4-5 are animated NOWHERE ELSE in the anime — this special is their sole appearance. Nothing in the reader's position depends on it (a two-page beat cannot move a position, and ch 1's position is owned by ep 4), but if the ledger note has room, the sentence worth keeping is: 'ch 1 pp. 4-5 (Luffy's knife scene, the under-eye scar's origin) are first animated here — every other ch 1 page is ep 4's, every ch 2 page is ep 1's.'

SOLE-ADAPTATION EXCEPTION, both halves stated as the rule requires: (1) the pages appear in NO other episode — HOLDS; (2) the beat is a major plot point of the source — FAILS (a cosmetic scar's origin, not a death / reveal / arc close). No flip; the row stays filler and the tie is an annotation, not an anchor.

RECAP SEMANTICS: I set `recap: false` deliberately and did NOT propose kind `recap`. The work is a newly produced 102-minute original special, not a compilation — Fuji TV 完全新作, ja-WP 完全新作ストーリーを中心に, ANN 'with new animation'. The recap is a SHARE inside it (ch 1 pp. 6-47 and the ch 2 pages, re-animated after eps 4 and 1), not the work's kind. If the ledger wants that share visible, it belongs in the note, never in `kind`.

T26 CREDIT LEDGER for this row (never adoption): 原作 尾田栄一郎 (franchise), 脚本 堤泰之 (ja-WP, ANN, Fuji TV), ANN 'Oda is supervising the special with its new story', Fuji TV 「原作者・尾田栄一郎書き下ろしの新世界編でのコビー＆ヘルメッポが初登場」 and 「ジエゴ、ヘジス、ビリッチは尾田栄一郎×久田和也のコラボデザイン」, ファッションデザイン 工藤静香. Designs and supervision only — nothing of this story enters the manga line. (The post-timeskip Koby/Helmeppo DESIGNS do reach the manga later, ch 903 per the wiki's Qref — a design precedence trivium, not an adoption of events.)

POSITION FORK for the sitting: broadcast order = 576.51 (confirmed, delivered); in-universe candidates = ~574.5 (official / ANN 'a little before Film Z', and AniList's SEQUEL edge to Film Z) or ~578.5 (the wiki's hedged 'after Z's Ambition Arc and Film Z, before Punk Hazard'). They contradict; the whole 575-578 block is filler, so the choice moves no reader position. No correction proposed.

NO REPAIRS. kind `special` confirmed (ja-WP スペシャル番組 / 2時間スペシャル番組, 土曜プレミアム; the wiki's 'sixth TV Special'); date 2012-12-15 confirmed on four sources incl. syobocal's airing rows (with a 2013-12-29 rerun, Flag 9 — never the stored date); the stored AniList title is a fair rendering (the wiki translates it 'Episode of Luffy: Adventure on Hand Island', Fuji TV writes 「ワンピース エピソード オブ ルフィ～ハンドアイランドの冒険～」) — a display choice, not an error.

OUT OF SCOPE, THE SAME TEST IS OWED: the one-piece triage's OTHER 'adapts_chapters: yes' work, 3D2Y (a newly drawn retelling of Marineford's climax, ch 574, and the Sabaody reunion, chs 598-602), is the identical recap-boundary shape — pages the TV run already animated. It must be tested page-by-page against the coverage set before any canon/mixed standing, or it will inherit exactly the false positive this verdict just refuted.

SOURCE-LINEAGE HONESTY: the page-level numbers are the One Piece Wiki's, in two different instruments (the episode infobox, added post-broadcast 2012-12-23 rev 800582; and the character-page {{Qref}} reverse index) that agree with each other. The chapter-level claim, the original-story claim and the 'new animation' claim are independently carried by ja-WP, Fuji TV, Mantan Web and ANN. No non-wiki source prints page numbers, and Shueisha's own readers are closed to us (MangaPlus 403). Nothing turns on the exact page count of the recap share.

SILENCE, NOT A FINDING: no source claims any first-time ch-2 page. Episode 1's notes list manga material it dropped (Koby's two-year boat; the island setting moved to the Lady Mary), and the special moves the same scene again to Alvida's own ship (the Miss Love Duck) rather than restoring the manga's island — so the ch-2 share looks wholly duplicate, but I found no positive statement either way and every ch-2 {{Qref}} page points at ep 1.
